name: milo-browse
title: OPC UA Browser
description: Connect to OPC UA servers using the binary protocol for browsing the node tree.
label: iot

properties.name: endpointUri
properties.description: The OPC UA server endpoint

properties.name: clientId
properties.description: A virtual client id to force the creation of a new connection instance

properties.name: depth
properties.description: When browsing recursively into sub-types, what's the maximum search depth for diving into the tree. Default value notice: Maximum depth for browsing recursively (only if recursive = true)

properties.name: direction
properties.description: The direction to browse (forward, inverse, ...). Default value notice: The direction to browse; see org.eclipse.milo.opcua.stack.core.types.enumerated.BrowseDirection

properties.name: discoveryEndpointSuffix
properties.description: A suffix for endpoint URI when discovering

properties.name: discoveryEndpointUri
properties.description: An alternative discovery URI

properties.name: filter
properties.description: Filter out node ids to limit browsing. Default value notice: Regular filter expression matching node ids

properties.name: includeSubTypes
properties.description: Whether to include sub-types for browsing; only applicable for non-recursive browsing

properties.name: maxNodeIdsPerRequest
properties.description: The maximum number node ids requested per server call. Default value notice: Maximum number of node ids requested per browse call (applies to browsing sub-types only; only if recursive = true)

properties.name: node
properties.description: The node definition (see Node ID). Default value notice: Root folder as per OPC-UA spec

properties.name: nodeClasses
properties.description: The mask indicating the node classes of interest in browsing. Default value notice: Comma-separated node class list; see org.eclipse.milo.opcua.stack.core.types.enumerated.NodeClass

properties.name: recursive
properties.description: Whether to browse recursively into sub-types, ignores includeSubTypes setting as it's implied to be set to true. Default value notice: Whether to recursively browse sub-types: truefalse

properties.name: lazyStartProducer
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

properties.name: allowedSecurityPolicies
properties.label: client
properties.description: A set of allowed security policy URIs. Default is to accept all and use the highest.

properties.name: applicationName
properties.label: client
properties.defaultValue: Apache Camel adapter for Eclipse Milo
properties.description: The application name

properties.name: applicationUri
properties.label: client
properties.description: The application URI

properties.name: channelLifetime
properties.label: client
properties.description: Channel lifetime in milliseconds

properties.name: keyAlias
properties.label: client
properties.description: The name of the key in the keystore file

properties.name: keyPassword
properties.label: client
properties.description: The key password

properties.name: keyStorePassword
properties.label: client
properties.description: The keystore password

properties.name: keyStoreType
properties.label: client
properties.description: The key store type

properties.name: keyStoreUrl
properties.label: client
properties.description: The URL where the key should be loaded from

properties.name: maxPendingPublishRequests
properties.label: client
properties.description: The maximum number of pending publish requests

properties.name: maxResponseMessageSize
properties.label: client
properties.description: The maximum number of bytes a response message may have

properties.name: overrideHost
properties.label: client
properties.description: Override the server reported endpoint host with the host from the endpoint URI.

properties.name: overridePort
properties.label: client
properties.description: Override the server reported endpoint port with the port from the endpoint URI.

properties.name: productUri
properties.label: client
properties.description: The product URI

properties.name: requestedPublishingInterval
properties.label: client
properties.description: The requested publishing interval in milliseconds

properties.name: requestTimeout
properties.label: client
properties.description: Request timeout in milliseconds

properties.name: sessionName
properties.label: client
properties.description: Session name

properties.name: sessionTimeout
properties.label: client
properties.description: Session timeout in milliseconds

properties.name: password
properties.label: security
properties.description: The password for authentication. Use this instead of embedding credentials in the endpoint URI when the password contains special characters (such as {code }, {code /}, {code }, {code &}).

properties.name: username
properties.label: security
properties.description: The username for authentication. Use this instead of embedding credentials in the endpoint URI when the username contains special characters (such as {code }, {code /}, {code }, {code &}).
